name: Charminar
blurb: Four-minaret landmark built by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah, surrounded by the Laad Bazaar and Irani chai cafes.
bestTime: Evening, when the market is lit up

spots.title: Minaret through the bazaar
spots.how: Shoot from the Laad Bazaar side with a shop awning framing the top corner. Wide lens, vertical crop.

spots.title: Chai and Charminar
spots.how: Sit at a cafe opposite the monument, hold a cup of Irani chai low in the frame with the arch behind it.

spots.title: Night-lights loop
spots.how: Use a 1-second exposure from the road divider to turn traffic into light trails.

name: Golconda Fort
blurb: Granite hill fort with famous acoustics at the Fateh Darwaza and a sound-and-light show in the evening.

spots.title: Clap-echo reel
spots.how: Stand under the entrance dome, clap once, and film the reaction of the person at the far end.

spots.title: Summit skyline
spots.how: Climb to the Baradari at the top and frame the city with a stone arch as the foreground.

spots.title: Stairway symmetry
spots.how: Centre the camera on the wide stone stairs and have your subject walk away from you.

name: Qutb Shahi Tombs
blurb: Domed tombs of the Qutb Shahi rulers set in landscaped gardens, quiet even on busy weekends.

spots.title: Dome row
spots.how: Line up several domes in one frame using a longer lens from the garden path.

spots.title: Arch portrait
spots.how: Place your subject inside a pointed arch with the dome visible above their head.

name: Chowmahalla Palace
blurb: Palace of the Nizams with courtyards, a Durbar Hall of chandeliers, and a vintage car gallery.

spots.title: Fountain courtyard
spots.how: Shoot along the long reflecting pool so the palace facade mirrors in the water.

spots.title: Chandelier look-up
spots.how: Point the camera straight up in the Durbar Hall for a symmetrical chandelier shot.

name: Warangal Fort
blurb: Kakatiya-era fort known for its stone gateways, the Kakatiya Kala Thoranam.

spots.title: Gateway frame
spots.how: Stand back and use the carved stone gateway as a natural frame around your subject.

spots.title: Ruins walk
spots.how: Film a slow walking shot through the ruins with the gateway in the distance.

name: Ramappa Temple
blurb: Kakatiya temple and UNESCO World Heritage Site, famous for detailed carvings and its lightweight 'floating' bricks.

spots.title: Carving close-up
spots.how: Get close to the pillar carvings and let the side light bring out the detail.

spots.title: Nandi and temple
spots.how: Frame the Nandi statue in the foreground with the temple in the background.

name: Taj Mahal
blurb: White marble mausoleum built by Shah Jahan, known for its symmetry and the changing colour of the marble through the day.

spots.title: Centre-line reflection
spots.how: Stand on the central walkway and line up the dome with the reflecting channel.

spots.title: Arch-framed Taj
spots.how: Shoot from inside the main gate so the arch frames the mausoleum.

spots.title: Mehtab Bagh view
spots.how: Cross the river to Mehtab Bagh for a calmer view of the Taj at sunset.

name: Red Fort
blurb: Red sandstone Mughal fort and UNESCO site, with the Lahori Gate and the Diwan-i-Aam.

spots.title: Lahori Gate wide
spots.how: Use a wide lens from the front lawn so the whole gate and flag sit in the frame.

spots.title: Sandstone arches
spots.how: Shoot down a row of arches in the Diwan-i-Aam to make a repeating pattern.

name: Hawa Mahal
blurb: The pink sandstone 'Palace of Winds' with 953 small windows designed so royal women could watch street life.

spots.title: Cafe-rooftop view
spots.how: Take the facade from a cafe across the street so the full building fits in one frame.

spots.title: Window portrait
spots.how: Go inside and frame your subject in one of the small windows looking out at the street.

name: Gateway of India
blurb: Basalt arch on the Mumbai waterfront, facing the Arabian Sea and the Taj Mahal Palace hotel.

spots.title: Arch with boats
spots.how: Shoot from the promenade with the harbour boats in the foreground.

spots.title: Blue-hour silhouette
spots.how: Have your subject stand under the arch and expose for the sky to make a clean silhouette.

name: Mysore Palace
blurb: Indo-Saracenic palace of the Wadiyar dynasty, lit by about 100,000 bulbs on Sundays and festival evenings.

spots.title: Illuminated facade
spots.how: Shoot from the front lawn during the Sunday lighting with a steady hand or a tripod.

spots.title: Garden path
spots.how: Line up the palace at the end of the garden path for depth.

name: Hampi, Vittala Temple
blurb: UNESCO site of the Vijayanagara Empire, home to the stone chariot and the musical pillars.

spots.title: Stone chariot
spots.how: Shoot the chariot from a low angle so it stands tall against the sky.

spots.title: Boulder sunset
spots.how: Climb Matanga Hill to catch the ruins and boulders in the evening light.
